messages:
Ravi (PM): starting a micro-surge canary for v2.4.0 -> api-search route, target 7% (change window 14:00-15:00 UTC). please monitor latency, 5xx, and embed quality.
Sara: quick heads-up: release notes updated here: https://release.redwood/v/2.4.0. rolling smoke now.
deploy-bot: deploy: v2.4.0 -> api-search initiated. target=7% started_at=1752468025. status=rolling
Ken SRE: infra: small p95 bump on two hosts, no OOMs. setting hold threshold: p99 > +120ms for 5m OR 5xx > 1.8% sustained 5m -> auto-rollback.
Liam: running local prompt-set evaluation for ranking/embeddings; will post delta in 6m.
Sara: observing ephemeral KV cache misses spike ~6% on canary hosts, not on baseline. linking logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/1752468000
Ken SRE: throttling new connections to canary pool to limit warmup stress. command: ```bash
redwood infra throttle --pool api-search-canary --concurrency 3
```
Ravi (PM): hold at 7% for 10m to validate. if metrics stable after 10m we'll advance to 25%.
deploy-bot: routing: api-search pinned at v2.4.0 7% by Ken SRE at 1752468110. note=throttle=3
Liam: eval results: ranking downgrade on one prompt category (-2.3% MRR). not critical but worth watch. attaching sample.
Ken SRE: infra alerting: increased connection churn on host canary-3, investigating. opening ticket INF-4021.
Sara: can we snapshot logs and mark for postmortem if we roll back? will draft a short incident template now.
Ravi (PM): agreed. rollback plan: back to v2.3.9 if auto-rollback triggers. manual rollback if human consensus. support notified.
deploy-bot: monitor update at 1752468340: error_rate=1.05% p99_delta=78ms kv_miss_delta=6% status=held
Ken SRE: for clarity, manual rollback command if needed: ```bash
redwood deploy rollback --route api-search --to-version v2.3.9 --reason "canary regressions"
```
Ravi (PM): reconvene in 10m for go/no-go to 25%. post final decision to #release-updates. :white_check_mark:
